name: Summer Discovery at UT Austin
org: The University of Texas at Austin Office of Admissions with Summer Discovery
what_you_do: Take college style, non credit courses or a one subject academy on the UT campus. Classes meet Monday to Thursday. You can live in a campus dorm or commute.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12. Participation does not guarantee admission to UT Austin.
pay_detail: Costs $3,799 to $7,999 depending on the options chosen (the Summer Discovery page gives one range). Some courses add fees. Financial aid is not mentioned.
duration: 2 week or 3 week sessions (2026: June 14 to 26 and June 28 to July 17)
deadline_text: 2026 sessions were June 14 to 26 and June 28 to July 17. 2027 dates and deadlines are not posted on the pages I read.
how_to_apply: Click the Apply Now button on the UT page. Summer Discovery, not UT, handles applications and sign-up. You can email summerdiscovery@utexas.edu. Or call 516-447-4907.
notes: Expensive. Students get a certificate of completion and a campus grade letter. The Summer Discovery page shows an early enrollment discount ending Oct 31 but does not say the year.
